game.title: Container: 10th Anniversary Jumbo Edition!
game.summary: 工場でコンテナを生産・値付けし、他人の商品を倉庫で仕入れ直して値付けし、船で島へ運んでブラインド競りにかける、プレイヤー主導の閉鎖経済ゲーム。
game.title_ja: コンテナ：10周年記念ジャンボ版

nodes.normalized_statement: Each player receives a player board, ship, starting money and bluff cards, a scoring/value card, and the starting factory and warehouse components specified by the retail rules; the central island and common container supply are prepared.

After paying required loan interest, a player performs exactly two actions. Actions may include building factories or warehouses, producing containers, purchasing containers into the harbor store, and sailing the ship; the same action may generally be chosen twice except where the rules restrict it.

Produced containers are offered from factory stores at prices chosen by their owners. Other players may purchase them into warehouse stores and set new prices, creating the player-driven production and wholesale market.

Sailing a loaded ship to the island triggers a blind auction for its containers. After bids are revealed, the ship owner may accept the highest bid, receiving that payment plus a matching subsidy from the bank, or pay the bank the amount of the highest bid to keep the shipment.
The game ends when the common supply of containers has been exhausted in two colors.

At final scoring, containers on the island are valued according to each player's secret value card and the edition's set/scoring rules, remaining cash is included, and outstanding loans are penalized as specified. The player with the highest final total wins.
